result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well structured, but there is a clearly broken image in the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon), and several layout/overflow problems: the 'Fastest near you' carousel card is clipped at the right edge with truncated text ('Trattoria Piccol...'), the category chip row is cut off mid-chip, and the second popular card (pizza) is cropped by the bottom navigation bar without visible title/metadata. Found 6 issues.

issues.description: The hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' failed to load and renders as an empty grey box with a broken-image glyph, unlike all other cards which show artwork.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset for this restaurant and add a branded fallback placeholder (e.g. cuisine icon or restaurant initial) plus a loading skeleton so failures degrade gracefully instead of showing a broken-image icon.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-clipped at the screen edge and its name and delivery price are cut off with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek so the next card is partially but deliberately visible, and truncate labels with an ellipsis; ensure the card content is not sliced mid-glyph.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is clipped mid-chip after 'Healthy', showing only a sliver of the next chip, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Reveal a consistent partial chip or add a fade/gradient mask and scroll indicator at the right edge of the chip row.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is cut off by the bottom navigation bar; its restaurant name, rating and delivery info are not visible, and the content appears to slide under the nav rather than stopping above it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the nav bar height (plus safe area) so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between cards: the ramen card uses a light grey circle on the grey placeholder (low contrast, nearly invisible) while the pizza card uses a dark circle.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent heart button treatment with a semi-opaque dark scrim or drop shadow so it is legible on any background, including empty placeholders.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' and the 'DELIVER TO' label uses light grey on white, which may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colour to meet WCAG AA contrast, and verify the green 'See all' links against the white background as well.
